message.content:
Below is a quick‑look list of the **federal public holidays that create long weekends in Canada for 2023**.  
(If you need province‑specific dates—e.g., Family Day in Alberta, British Columbia, etc.—let me know and I can add those.)

| Holiday | Date (2023) | Weekend days that form the long weekend | Notes |
|---------|-------------|----------------------------------------|-------|
| **New Year’s Day** (observed) | Monday Jan 2 | Sunday Jan 1 – Tuesday Jan 3 | New Year’s Day fell on Sunday, so it’s observed on Monday. |
| **Family Day** (Ontario, Alberta, Saskatchewan, Manitoba, New Brunswick, Prince Edward Island) | Monday Feb 20 | Saturday Feb 18 – Monday Feb 20 | Third Monday in February. |
| **Good Friday** | Friday Apr 7 | Friday Apr 7 – Sunday Apr 9 | Friday holiday. |
| **Victoria Day** | Monday May 22 | Saturday May 20 – Monday May 22 | Celebrates Queen Victoria’s birthday. |
| **Canada Day** (observed) | Monday Jul 3 | Saturday Jul 1 – Monday Jul 3 | Canada Day fell on Saturday, so it’s observed on Monday. |
| **Labour Day** | Monday Sep 4 | Saturday Sep 2 – Monday Sep 4 | First Monday in September. |
| **Thanksgiving** | Monday Oct 9 | Saturday Oct 7 – Monday Oct 9 | Second Monday in October. |
| **Remembrance Day** (observed) | Monday Nov 13 | Saturday Nov 11 – Monday Nov 13 | Remembrance Day fell on Saturday, so it’s observed on Monday. |
| **Christmas Day** | Monday Dec 25 | Saturday Dec 23 – Monday Dec 25 | Christmas Day itself is on Monday. |

**Key points**

* **Boxing Day** (Dec 26) is a federal holiday but falls on a Tuesday in 2023, so it does **not** create a long weekend.  
* Some provinces have additional holidays that can create long weekends (e.g., St. Patrick’s Day in Newfoundland & Labrador, St. George’s Day in Prince Edward Island, etc.). If you need those, just let me know which provinces you’re interested in.  
* For most of the holidays above, the long weekend is the two‑day weekend (Saturday–Sunday) plus the holiday day (either Friday or Monday).  

Feel free to copy this table into your holiday‑planning app, or let me know if you’d like it in a different format (JSON, CSV, etc.).
